thread:
marcus: FYI, after the KV prefetcher tweak (PR #4203) I'm seeing sporadic NaNs in downstream gen for fp8 paged-attn.
marcus: Repro on local with --quant=fpx8 yields softmax inf/NaN when seq_len>1024 and kv prefetcher window=64.
priya: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro + logs?
marcus: log snippet:
```
runtime: selected kernel=flash_attn_v2_prefetch
softmax: max=1.2e+38 exp overflow -> inf
qkv: dtype=fp8 e4m3
result: NaN detected at token 1273
```
eli: do we have guardrails in kernel selector for numeric range? kernel switch should fallback to bf16 or stable softmax.
zoe: selector only checks shape/hw, not numeric headroom. prefetcher was added to reduce kv-load latency and it changed memory layout slightly.
priya: can we toggle prefetcher off as a quick mitigation for Dedicated clusters?
marcus: rolled a rollback to prefetcher=false on canary already. metrics back to baseline but still investigating root cause.
eli: posting profiler flamegraph — prefetcher increases headroom for reordering, maybe causes different accumulation order -> different rounding -> softmax blowup for extreme logits.
marcus: experiment: forcing softmax scale = logit - max(logit) fixed NaNs locally. So softmax stability issue amplified by fp8 dynamic range.
priya: good find. we should patch kernel to run stable_softmax when dtype==fp8 or when max(logit)-min(logit)>X.
zoe: open question: do we prefer software softmax fallback or automatic kernel switch? perf tradeoffs: software fallback costs ~2.3x for that op but maintains output quality.
eli: benchmark numbers on g4dn: flash_prefetch fp8 w/ stable-softmax fallback -> latency +45ms on a 2k seq test, but no NaNs. raw flash_prefetch fp8 -> +0ms but NaNs.
priya: let's add selector rule: if dtype==fp8 && seq_len>=1024 -> use fused-stable-softmax kernel or fallback to bf16 variant.
marcus: I'll prepare PR: add numeric-safety check to kernel selector and a small opt to compute max(logit) in fp16 before exp.
deploy-bot: canary rollback completed for service/hosted-inference (deploy 2026-03-16T09:12:00Z) :white_check_mark: \
zoe: also add unit tests with adversarial logits (e.g., 1e38, -1e38) and quantized roundtrip.
eli: assign: marcus (investigate kernel patch), priya (selector rule + canary mitigations), zoe (tests/benchmarks).
marcus: noted. will push PR today and tag perf team.
priya: thanks — logging issue with reproduction script in #eng-infra too.
marcus: I'll move the repro gist to shared drive and paste link in followup :link:
